js: (async()=>{try{const g=__gm;g.setTime(11);const P=g.P;P.reg=true;P.cls='warrior';P.lvl=10;g.combat().recalc();await g.spawnHero();const r=[];const sh=()=>document.querySelector('.gm-sheet.on h3');for(const [id,x,z] of [['oracle',125,-205],['runes',132,-208],['mimir',-462,-140],['sphinx',14,212],['pantheon',515,50]]){g.teleport(x,z);g.sim(5);g.goTo(id);for(let k=0;k<40&&!sh();k++){g.sim(10);await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,50));}r.push([id, sh()?sh().textContent:'-']);document.querySelector('.gm-sheet').classList.remove('on');}const w=g.town.waystones.find(w=>w.id==='elves');g.teleport(w.x+4,w.z);g.sim(40);await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,700));g.sim(5);r.push(['ways',JSON.stringify(P.ways)]);g.combat().H.combatT=0;g.nav().travel(w);await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,900));r.push(['pos',Math.round(g.agent.x),Math.round(g.agent.z)]);g.cam.dist=g.cam.tDist=16;g.cam.pitch=g.cam.tPitch=.3;g.sim(20);await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,3000));g.sim(3);return r}catch(e){return String(e.stack).slice(0,900)}})()
